description.value: The Templeton is a nostalgic American-style diner in the heart of Vancouver's Granville entertainment district, dishing up all-day breakfast made with free-run eggs and naturally smoked bacon alongside gourmet burgers and authentic milkshakes. The retro atmosphere features a jukebox and a no-reservations, first-come first-served policy that keeps things lively. Fully licensed and indoors-only, it is a locally loved comfort-food destination in a central, high-traffic part of downtown Vancouver.
